usage: UnifyRepresentation.py [-h] [--platform PLATFORM] [--var_fn VAR_FN]
                              [--ref_fn REF_FN]
                              [--candidate_details_fn CANDIDATE_DETAILS_FN]
                              [--output_vcf_fn OUTPUT_VCF_FN]
                              [--sampleName SAMPLENAME] [--ctgName CTGNAME]
                              [--ctgStart CTGSTART] [--ctgEnd CTGEND]
                              [--max_candidates_distance MAX_CANDIDATES_DISTANCE]
                              [--max_calculate_count MAX_CALCULATE_COUNT]
                              [--partition_size PARTITION_SIZE]
                              [--minimum_allele_gap MINIMUM_ALLELE_GAP]
                              [--bed_fn BED_FN] [--vcf_fn VCF_FN]

Representation unification for candidate site and true variant

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform PLATFORM   Sequencing platform of the input. Options:
                        'ont,hifi,ilmn', default: ont
  --var_fn VAR_FN       Truth variants list input from GetTruth.py
  --ref_fn REF_FN       Reference fasta file input, default: ref.fa
  --candidate_details_fn CANDIDATE_DETAILS_FN
                        Read-level candidate details file, default: None
  --output_vcf_fn OUTPUT_VCF_FN
                        VCF output filename or stdout if not set,default: None
  --sampleName SAMPLENAME
                        Define the sample name to be shown in the VCF file,
                        optional
  --ctgName CTGNAME     The name of the sequence to be processed
  --ctgStart CTGSTART   The 1-based starting position of the sequence to be
                        processed, optional, will process the whole --ctgName
                        if not set
  --ctgEnd CTGEND       The 1-based inclusive ending position of the sequence
                        to be processed, optional, will process the whole
                        --ctgName if not set
  --max_candidates_distance MAX_CANDIDATES_DISTANCE
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Maximum distance between subsequent
                        variants within a group
  --max_calculate_count MAX_CALCULATE_COUNT
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Maximum calculation times for chunk
                        window
  --partition_size PARTITION_SIZE
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Maximum variants in per group size
  --minimum_allele_gap MINIMUM_ALLELE_GAP
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Minimum allele gap filtering candidate
                        path generation
  --bed_fn BED_FN       Candidate sites VCF file input, if provided, will
                        choose candidate +/- 1 or +/- 2. Use together with
                        gen4Training. default: None
  --vcf_fn VCF_FN       Candidate sites VCF file input, if provided, will
                        choose candidate +/- 1 or +/- 2. Use together with
                        gen4Training. default: None
